evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: pas d'analyses « one shot » ici. Chaque dashboard, chaque extraction est pensée pour être réutilisable et scalable
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Scalability, industrialization, and quality/governance language ('Garantir la qualité et la fiabilité', 'bonnes pratiques de gouvernance') is balanced against a start-up/agile framing ('L'équipe fonctionne comme une start-up', 'esprit agile, autonomie forte'), giving parity and a mixed classification.
evidence.domain_risk: tu collabores avec les équipes métiers (Immobilier, Finance, Marketing, Comptabilité…)
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: The role touches Finance and Comptabilité (accounting) and centralizes ERP data group-wide, but there is no explicit financial reporting/regulatory/audit language, keeping it at moderate.
evidence.collaboration_width: Immobilier; Finance; Marketing; Comptabilité; Data Scientists
evidence.data_team_maturity: de son ingestion dans notre plateforme Data (Snowflake) jusqu'à la création de dashboards clairs et percutants, accessibles à plus de 10 000 collaborateurs
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: Named tooling (Snowflake, dbt) is used in responsibilities to serve 10,000+ employees, and existing pipelines/models are being optimized and evolved rather than built from zero, indicating a mid-maturity function.
evidence.jd_authorship: de son ingestion dans notre plateforme Data (Snowflake) jusqu'à la création de dashboards clairs et percutants
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: The role is described with specific tools (Snowflake, dbt), scale (10,000+ employees), and a concrete Build/Run framing, letting the reader clearly understand the day-to-day work.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: tu collabores avec les équipes métiers (Immobilier, Finance, Marketing, Comptabilité…)
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: Four distinct business functions (real estate, finance, marketing, accounting) are named as roughly equal partners with no single dominant orientation, so mixed.
evidence.autonomy_level: tu identifies les points d'amélioration et n'hésites pas à challenger l'existant
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role is expected to challenge existing approaches and own data model architecture (strategic) while also translating specific business team requests into solutions (execution), producing a mixed autonomy level.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: Despite the Analytics team being part of a 'pôle Data, en charge de l'IA et de la data', no AI skill or tooling is expected of the candidate anywhere in responsibilities or requirements.
evidence.testing_framing: Garantir la qualité et la fiabilité : tu veilles à ce que chaque chiffre communiqué soit juste. Tu mets en place les bonnes pratiques de gouvernance et de contrôle qualité
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Data quality and governance are framed as an owned responsibility with explicit action verbs ('Garantir', 'tu mets en place'), not just a listed tool skill.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Tu es garant(e) de la solidité et de la fiabilité de notre architecture data
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Reliability and accuracy of data reaching decision-makers is a recurring theme but secondary to the delivery/build framing of the role, placing this at moderate.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Build → tu conçois de nouveaux pipelines, dashboards et outils data... Run → tu assures la maintenance, corriges les éventuels bugs
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The JD explicitly frames responsibilities as both Build (new pipelines/dashboards) and Run (maintenance, bug fixes, evolving existing pipelines), giving a mixed signal.
evidence.work_arrangement: Statut à distance Hybride / Localisation : La Défense (2 jours de télétravail par semaine)
evidence.loss_aversion: Garantir la qualité et la fiabilité : tu veilles à ce que chaque chiffre communiqué soit juste — reliability is framed as an ownership duty but within a broader build/deliver context, not a dominant risk register.
